content: Hey there! Thanks for stopping by my website. How can I help you today? Or perhaps, what brought you here?

Well, that's me you're talking about!

I'm Durvesh Danve, a Software Engineer II at Cohesity. My main gig involves building and owning production systems, working across backend, frontend, and distributed systems. I'm pretty big on ownership, performance, and reliability – basically, I build systems that can't fail and are used by large enterprises.

I spend a lot of my time designing and shipping both backend and frontend systems that operate at enterprise and petabyte scale, especially in data management and protection. I'm also a big believer in leveraging AI in my engineering workflows, using agentic tools and generative AI to speed things up and ship reliable software.

So, in a nutshell, I build robust software solutions, and I do it efficiently, often with a little help from AI.
